## What changes?

One bounded problem and the change addressing it.

## Evidence and checks

- [ ] Build, typecheck, application tests, and public-source checks
- [ ] Regression check for changed behavior, or an explanation
- [ ] Preserved contracts, history, and review restrictions
- [ ] Isolated fixtures; no private data or production test writes
- [ ] UI changes: keyboard access, mobile layout, and reduced motion

List actual results and anything not run. For AI-assisted work, say what you checked.

## Limitations and next check

What might still be wrong? What should the next reviewer inspect?
